entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What!? He knows everything!?[n]You gotta be fucking kidding!
entries.uk: Що?! Він усе знає?![n]Та ти, блін, знущаєшся!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, are you OK? Did he[n]report you or anything?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We likely wouldn't be[n]receiving these messages[n]if [fName] was not OK.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I had a feeling that Boss[n]was no ordinary man...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But he didn't recommend you[n]turn yourself in, did he?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I think in that case we can[n]consider him a new ally.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm more curious about[n]what he mentioned to you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You mean how our enemy might[n]be the same people who targeted[n]Futaba's mother?
entries.uk: Тобто що наш ворог — можливо,[n]ті самі люди, що обрали мішенню[n]матір Футаби?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes. She was killed by mental[n]shutdown, the same method used[n]by the culprit we pursue now.
entries.uk: Так. Її вбили психічним[n]відключенням — тим самим способом,[n]що й злочинець, якого ми шукаємо.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait a second though...[n]Didn't you say Boss had[n]to "run from it all"...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Does that mean someone was trying[n]to stop the news from getting out?[n]Who could do that...?
entries.uk: Тобто хтось не давав новинам[n]вийти назовні?[n]Хто на таке здатен...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Who do you think[n]the culprit could be?
A government official.
Someone very powerful.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't you letting your[n]imagination run wild a bit?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But it would make sense.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait a sec! If you're right,[n]then wouldn't the police be[n]working for 'em too!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...That's not impossible.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is getting too big for[n]me to even think about...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Can we really win this?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We're gonna win, no matter what!
